notes:
Fixed reversed Debit/Credit entries for GST vouchers:
- Both Purchase (GSTR-2B) and Sales (GSTR-1) vouchers were booking with the wrong side as Debit/Credit in Tally — now fixed to use Tally's real native sign convention.
- Voucher No. is now set to the invoice number for GST imports, instead of leaving Tally to auto-number.

New:
- "Recheck Duplicates Against Tally" button on GSTR-1 and GSTR-2B Tally Import — clears a stale "Duplicate Invoice" flag when the earlier voucher was deleted directly in Tally, without needing to re-upload the file.

Important: any vouchers imported before this update may have Debit/Credit reversed — please check and re-import if needed.
